Use case: stylized-concept. Production mobile portrait environment background for fullscreen fantasy card game Tavern Brawl. 1024x1536 portrait. Match the reference midnight tavern's sophisticated painterly material, warm hearth on left and cold blue moonlight on right, blue-black dueling table, slender worn brass edge, black walnut foreground. Recompose for phone: tavern rafters and distant windows occupy only top 18%; a clean dark blue table surface fills middle 58%; dark wooden foreground the bottom 24%. Left and right rails narrow, props only at outer edges. No cards, card slots, characters, heroes, UI, letters, buttons, title, gems or numbers anywhere. Deep ink teal center has clear usable space for two opposing rows of large live character cards. Small amber candle flame near right edge at 55% height, faint tavern silhouettes high in distant background. Atmospheric natural light, precise fine material, rich shadow separation, never green felt. No baked interface, logos or watercolor.
